subject.title: feat(cli): add lightweight context flag to agent turns

question: Should one-shot `openclaw agent` callers have a supported opt-in `--light-context` mode that omits workspace bootstrap files?
rationale: The implementation is mechanically narrow and uses an existing runtime mode, but publishing this CLI option establishes a durable user-facing context-selection contract that changes the instruction set seen by opted-in runs.

options.title: Adopt the opt-in flag
options.body: Approve `--light-context` for bounded machine tasks while retaining full workspace context as the default for all existing callers.

options.title: Keep the mode internal
options.body: Do not expose the flag and continue limiting lightweight bootstrap selection to existing runtime-owned callers.

recommendation.title: Adopt the opt-in flag
recommendation.body: Approve `--light-context` for bounded machine tasks while retaining full workspace context as the default for all existing callers.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the only concrete person connected to the reviewed implementation in the available evidence; a current-main history pass should identify the appropriate final owner.
